meta.title: Bats in the Night Sky
meta.textType: facts and pictures: yes or no

paragraphs: On Saturday, the Explorers went to the nature park in the evening. The sun went down behind the hills. Ranger Mark took them to a high place by the lake. They had a good view of the trees and the sky. The air was cool, and the lake was very quiet. Mia held a small pencil and some paper in her hand. Soon, many small creatures flew out of the trees. They were bats! That night, Mia wrote a fact file for Explorers' Blog.

"A bat is a small creature with soft fur. It is not a bird, but it can fly. Its wings are made of thin skin. A bat is the only animal with fur that can fly. Many bats are small, and some live in caves.

Bats sleep in the day. At night, they leave their cave and look for food. A bat makes a high sound, and the sound comes back from an insect. So the bat knows where the insect is. A small bat can eat many insects in one night. Some bats eat fruit, but most bats eat insects.

Bats are good for the environment. They eat insects, and this helps the plants and the people near the park. Ranger Mark wants us to keep the park dark at night. Strong lights are bad for bats. Bats do not hurt people. I have one wish. I want to see a bat in a cave in the day. Leo drew a cartoon of a bat in a funny hat for the blog.

True or false? One: A bat is a bird. Two: Bats sleep in the day. Three: A bat can fly. Four: A bat leaves its cave in the morning. Answers: one is false, two is true, three is true, and four is false."
text.summary: The Explorers watch bats in the evening in the nature park with Ranger Mark. Mia writes a fact file about bats, and it ends with a box of true or false statements.
